literature_notes: Seven ledger lines were examined. L1/L2/L3 (PMC4610628) describe HA-CD229(434–655), a truncated chimeric construct in which the entire ectodomain is replaced by an HA tag fused to the short extracellular linker + TM + IC domain. Although the construct is membrane-anchored and the HA is surface-displayed, it is not a tag inserted into a site of full-length LY9 — the ectodomain (residues 48–433) is entirely absent. The rules require the construct to be full-length and membrane-anchored; this one fails the full-length criterion. L4/L5 (PMC9740379) report FLAG-tagged CD229 cDNA in the commercial lentiviral vector CD513B-1, but the tag position is completely unstated; the rules explicitly exclude such cases. L6/L7 (PMC12242830) report a validated C-terminal DDK/FLAG tag inserted immediately upstream of the stop codon (after residue 655), which is intracellular (IC: 476–655); this is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line supports a tag insertion at a specific site on the extracellular face of full-length, membrane-anchored LY9.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal DDK (DYKDDDDK) tag inserted immediately upstream of the stop codon (after Thr655); residue 655 is intracellular (IC: 476–655), so this is not a surface tag site.
